set.body: Harden modules/image before expanding pipeline syntax. Scope: exact grid identity; space-bound ROI algebra and NeuroVol/NeuroVec selection; shape-preserving map and checked zip operations; explicit sparse support policy; immutable public storage; valid cluster and searchlight states. Do not add NeuroImage flatMap: compose fallible stages through Either or Kleisli. Completion requires shared adversarial tests and JVM plus Scala.js verification.
set.title: EPIC: typed image regions and functional spatial pipelines
